findings.diagnosis: BIG, 'Improve account access', estimates six days and combines a three-day session-token verifier with an independent three-day account-recovery UI. Either can ship alone, so bundling them hides separate progress and delays one deliverable behind the other.
findings.recommended_action: Split BIG into a session-token verifier ticket and an account-recovery UI ticket, each estimated at three days, preserving the parent and allowing independent delivery.
